items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: I did some work with and for some people. Some people in town. Senator Jones is going to come to mind.

ctx.x: So what was, I'm moving along, after Imperial, what were your other clients after Imperial? I mean, after you?

After Imperial, I did some work with and for some people. Some people in town. Senator Jones is going to come to mind. I did some, then I met this fellow called Sigmund Walker, or whatever. I forgot his first name, Shane. But anyway, he had connection with a company in Mississippi called Malico Records. You know, they was down in the dumps here. They was doing some commercial stuff in Mississippi. That day, you know, country and western, I would imagine, type stuff. And so he went over there and he made a deal…
I was looking at this in 62, for the NOLA library. I recognize you sitting at the desk with her.
